title: vaccinium minus
intro: Vaccinium minus, commonly known as Dwarf Bilberry, is a small shrub-like plant that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, and is known for its edible fruits, which resemble small blueberries. The health benefits of Vaccinium minus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The plant's bioactive constituents include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
